name: @ondewo/sip-client-typescript
description: ONDEWO Session Initiation Protocol (SIP) Client library for Typescript
author: ONDEWO GmbH <office@ondewo.com>

scripts.pretest: tsc auth/offlineTokenProvider.ts auth/offlineTokenProvider.spec.ts auth/grpcWebEndpoint.spec.ts examples/ts-client.ts examples/ts-client.spec.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2020 --strict --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck --sourceMap --types node --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types --outDir .test-build && ln -sfn ../api .test-build/api && npm run build:test:protos
scripts.test: npm run test:auth && npm run test:examples && npm run test:protos && npm run test:release
scripts.test:release: tsc tests/releaseNotes.spec.ts tests/releaseCredentials.spec.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2020 --strict --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck --types node --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types --outDir .test-build && node --test .test-build/releaseNotes.spec.js .test-build/releaseCredentials.spec.js
scripts.build:test:protos: tsc tests/bundleStringRoundTrip.spec.ts --ignoreConfig --module commonjs --target es2020 --strict --lib es2020,dom --skipLibCheck --sourceMap --types node --typeRoots ./node_modules/@types --outDir .test-build
